queries.jql: project = EDM AND statusCategory = "In Progress" AND assignee is EMPTY

disabledRuleReasons.in-progress-no-fix-version: Pending Flight Control owner confirmation that active Features and Epics require a release assignment.
disabledRuleReasons.epic-no-parent-feature: Pending Flight Control hierarchy policy confirmation for Epic parent requirements.
disabledRuleReasons.no-component: Pending Flight Control classification policy confirmation for Jira Components.
disabledRuleReasons.no-team: Pending Flight Control Team-field mapping and ownership policy confirmation; the collector does not request a Team field.

rules.name: In Progress Feature/Epic without Fix Version
rules.description: Features and Epics that are In Progress must have a Fix Version.
rules.remediation: Assign the appropriate Fix Version after confirming release scope.
rules.disabledReason: Pending Flight Control owner confirmation that active Features and Epics require a release assignment.

rules.name: In Progress issue without Assignee
rules.description: All In Progress issues must have an assignee.
rules.remediation: Assign an owner for the active issue.
rules.jql: project = EDM AND statusCategory = "In Progress" AND assignee is EMPTY

rules.name: Open Epic without parent Feature
rules.description: Epics that are not Done should be linked to a parent Feature.
rules.remediation: Link the Epic to its parent Feature when the hierarchy policy requires it.
rules.disabledReason: Pending Flight Control hierarchy policy confirmation for Epic parent requirements.

rules.name: Open issue without Component
rules.description: All issues that are not Done should have at least one Component.
rules.remediation: Set a Jira Component when classification policy requires one.
rules.disabledReason: Pending Flight Control classification policy confirmation for Jira Components.

rules.name: Open issue without Team
rules.description: All issues that are not Done should have a Team assigned.
rules.remediation: Set the configured Jira Team field when ownership policy requires it.
rules.disabledReason: Pending Flight Control Team-field mapping and ownership policy confirmation; the collector does not request a Team field.

rules.name: In Progress issue without Assignee
rules.description: All In Progress issues must have an assignee.
rules.remediation: Assign an owner for the active issue.
